Quiet and unassuming, he was held in high esteem by all. Sgt. Ken Sheail was killed in action with the Hampshire Regiment in Italy, having previously been wounded there.
KEN SHEAIL was killed in action with the Hampshire Regiment in Italy, having previously been wounded there. His favourite distance with us was the 880 yards.

R.V.REYNOLDS was killed in Sicily and other promising lives lost in the Italian campaign;were KEN SHEAIL and LIONEL PENNY. In addition, there were PAT RIDGE and FRANK HANDLEY (both of the Irish Guards) killed in action, as were two other most promising athletes, K.N.
